1395-4460-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

618-3991-4247.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token.
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

872-3478-7857.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.

1978-5139-5793-7008.description:
Activate Relic of Sauron by tapping it, adding two mana.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Relic of Sauron which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

3617-7715-7722.easyPrerequisites: The Mighty Thor doesn't have summoning sickness.
3617-7715-7722.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using The Mighty Thor.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Walk from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

2919-2999-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-2999-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4613-5446-7096-7150.easyPrerequisites: You've had a land enter this turn.
4613-5446-7096-7150.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures, one of which must have a +1/+1 counter on it and hasn't used Kirol's ability this turn.
4613-5446-7096-7150.description:
Cast Esika's Chariot by paying {3}{G}.
When Esika's Chariot enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Kirol's ability by tapping two creatures you control, copying Esika's Chariot's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens, which each enter with a +1/+1 counter on them due to Bioengineered Future.
Repeat from step 3, using one of the Cats to activate Kirol's ability, and then tapping both Cats.

2724-4243-6432.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Venser, the Sojourner. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3259-4478-5659.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-5659.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2292-3175-4775.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

206-1350-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {4}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and four Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, four Halflings and four Foods by tapping them, adding {6}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
206-1350-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

813-4872-7339.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

11-2928-4377-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2928-4377-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Walk the Aeons.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Walk the Aeons spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Walk the Aeons spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Walk the Aeons and returning the original Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Walk the Aeons from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

3771-5639-7070.notablePrerequisites: You have one or fewer cards in hand.
3771-5639-7070.description:
Activate Arm-Mounted Anchor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Arm-Mounted Anchor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying at most {2} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
3771-5639-7070.notes: The starting cost can be reduced depending on the number of +1/+1 counters on Animar.

2034-2820-4679-6965.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

317-4211-5660.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tormod's Crypt ability.
Repeat.

2034-4593-6097-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-4593-6097-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

2073-6522-6798.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Mandibular Kite from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mandibular Kite enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Mandibular Kite to it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Mandibular Kite.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1429-2829-6792.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

880-5671-6763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-5671-6763.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

252-2099-4871.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

1824-4549-6518.easyPrerequisites: You have not entered or completed Tomb of Annihilation.
1824-4549-6518.description:
Cast Acererak either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Acererak enters the battlefield, its first ability and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Acererak, adding {B}.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand and causing you to venture into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1525-5751-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {1} and discarding a land.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

803-2364-3767-3918.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
803-2364-3767-3918.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
803-2364-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Mana Vault's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2921-6243-6288.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel in additional to its other types.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

643-2292-3951-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
643-2292-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

784-1477-1750-2793-5261.notablePrerequisites: Silas Renn cannot be blocked by an opponent.
784-1477-1750-2793-5261.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Silas Renn, triggering Silas Renn, targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2792-3489-4307.notablePrerequisites:
Yuriko does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{B}{B}.
2792-3489-4307.description:
Declare Yuriko as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Great Whale's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Yuriko from the battlefield to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Yuriko's ninjutsu ability by paying {U}{B} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Yuriko onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1742-1957-5308.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one creature card in hand.
1742-1957-5308.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a creature card, adding {B}.
Confessor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-914-4153-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
Dockside Extortionist does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-914-4153-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dockside Extortionist's power.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving all +1/+1 counters from Dockside Extortionist onto another permanent you control.
Repeat.
If opponents control six or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1633-2060-4120-4772-5032.description:
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard this turn.
Cast Hanabi Blast either from your hand or from the top of your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

4050-4616-4963.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
4050-4616-4963.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {1}.
The creature dies, triggering Moldervine Reclamation.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}, causing you to create a 2/2 Bear creature token the next time you would draw a card this turn.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2796-4046.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Aristocrat.
Cephalid Aristocrat triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat.

719-2034-3413.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Xenograft, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.
